name: Productivity
goal_hint: Assist with the requested productivity task inside the user's authenticated session.
strategy: Use the existing session (never ask for passwords in chat)
verification: Drafts prepared and shown; nothing sent or deleted without explicit user approval.
failure_handling: MFA or verification → ask_user. Ambiguous recipient or content → ask_user.
prompt_extra: Never send messages, delete data or change settings without explicit confirmation via ask_user.
